description: This source file defines the UAManager class, which adds PDF/UA (Accessibility) support to a PdfDocument in the PDFsharp library. It manages structure trees, event handling for page and graphics actions, and provides methods for accessibility features.

classes.name: UAManager
classes.description: Manages PDF/UA accessibility features for a PdfDocument, including structure tree management, event handling, and accessibility annotations.

methods.name: ForDocument
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the singleton UAManager instance for a given PdfDocument.

methods.name: SetDocumentLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language attribute of the PDF document.

methods.name: BeginTextMode
methods.description: Switches the current graphics context to text mode.

methods.name: BeginGraphicMode
methods.description: Switches the current graphics context to graphic mode.

methods.name: IsInTextMode
methods.description: Checks if the current graphics context is in text mode.
